description.value: Thai-Isaan is a small, family-run restaurant in Tsawwassen serving authentic homestyle Thai and Isaan cuisine made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The cozy, welcoming space is filled with traditional decorations and is well-suited to a solo dinner or a group meal after a day on the bike. Takeout is available for cyclists who need to eat on the go.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 40m; stands (4 spaces) at 97m. Total: 9 spaces.
